makemeahanzi.definition: to doubt, to question, to suspect

etymology.hint: An old man walking 疋 while holding 匕 a cane 矢

characterDeckComponents.note: 疋 — a person walking, shown pausing and looking back uncertainly
矢 (an arrow/cane) — an old man's walking stick, held while hesitating

etymology.hint: A tree 木 bearing berries 叒

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (tree) — 桑 names the mulberry tree.
叒 depicts clusters of leaves or berries — clustered on the tree 木, they gave 桑 its meaning 'mulberry tree.'

makemeahanzi.definition: weak, feeble; to decline, to falter

etymology.hint: A person in a robe 衣 with an injury 一 to his head 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 衣 (robe) surrounds the character, showing a person's clothing.
口 (here representing the head) inside shows an injury or weakness, giving 衰 its meaning 'to decline, wane.'
艹 (grass, plant) — 茜 (the madder plant) is a plant.
西 (xī) gives a sound only distantly related to qiàn today, a connection that has faded over roughly three millennia of sound change.

makemeahanzi.definition: merchant; to buy, to trade; surname

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (money) — trade and merchants are tied to money.
覀 (a variant form of 西) gives a sound distantly related to jiǎ, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: to put sb to the trouble

makemeahanzi.definition: to labor, to toil; to do manual work

etymology.hint: A man lifting 力 a load 冖 of grass 艹

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (grass) — a bundle of grass or straw carried as a load
力 (strength) — the effort of lifting and carrying the heavy load

etymology.hint: Known 知 clearly 日; 知 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 知 (to know) forms the upper part of the character.
日 (sun, clarity) — knowledge seen as clearly as the sun gave 智 its meaning 'wisdom.'

etymology.hint: A person's 亻 duty 责; 责 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 债 concerns something a person owes.
责 (duty, responsibility) — an obligation owed to someone else, together giving 债 its meaning 'debt, loan.'

etymology.hint: Hair 彡 growing on the face 页

characterDeckComponents.note: 彡 (hair) — growing hair.
页 (face/head) — hair growing on the face, originally 'beard, whiskers,' later extended to the abstract meaning of 须, 'must, necessary.'

makemeahanzi.definition: discipline, age; period, era; record, annal

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — 纪 relates to organizing threads in order, extended to mean 'record, era'
己 (jǐ) gives a sound close to 纪's reading jì
火 (fire) — cannons like 炮 fire using explosive force.
包 (bāo) gives a rhyme close to pào, sharing a related initial.
鱼 (fish) — abalone is a sea creature, grouped with the fish radical.
包 (bāo) gives the sound — a close match for bào, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: a saw; to saw, to amputate

characterDeckComponents.note: 钅 (metal) — 锯 (a saw) is a metal-bladed tool.
居 (jū) gives a sound close to jù, sharing the same sound and differing only in tone.
疒 (sickness) — the sickness radical, depicting a person lying on a sickbed — marking the character as related to illness.
隐 (yǐn) gives the sound — an exact match with 瘾's reading.

etymology.hint: To sell 卖 a soul for money 贝; 卖 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (shell/money) — the payment involved.
卖 (to sell) — combined with money, the image of buying something back, giving 赎 its meaning 'to redeem, ransom.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to take turns, to repeat; to sow; a turn

etymology.hint: Sowing seeds 米 on the farm 田

characterDeckComponents.note: 米 (grain) — 番 pictures seeds scattered by hand.
田 (a farm field) — seeds 米 sown onto a field 田 gave 番 its meaning 'a turn, a time' — as one crop follows another in turn.

meanings: (Tw) classifier for larger round objects (watermelon etc)

characterDeckComponents.note: 米 (rice) shows 粒 relates to small grains.
立 (lì) gives the exact sound of 粒.

makemeahanzi.definition: tube, pipe, cylinder; a thick piece of bamboo

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) — 筒 originally named a thick piece of hollow bamboo.
同 (tóng) gives a sound close to tǒng, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: fence, guard; to defend; idle time

etymology.hint: A wooden fence 木 with a door 门

characterDeckComponents.note: 门 (door, gate) — 闲 describes a fenced-in, quiet space.
木 (wood) — a wooden 木 fence with a door 门 pictures an enclosed, peaceful space, giving 闲 its meaning 'idle, at leisure.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to collect, to gather; to pick, to pluck

etymology.hint: A hand picking 爫 fruit from a tree 木

characterDeckComponents.note: 爫 (a hand, claw-like) — reaching to pick something.
木 (tree) — a hand picking fruit from a tree gave 采 its meaning 'to pick, gather, collect.'

meanings: used in the transliteration of Greek letters

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — a semantic radical common in characters used for foreign transliteration.
加 (jiā) gives the sound — an exact match with 伽.

meanings: algebraic term for a large number

etymology.hint: A capital building on a hill

characterDeckComponents.note: 京 depicts a tall building raised on a hill or mound — ancient capitals were built on elevated ground for defense, giving 京 its meaning 'capital city.'

makemeahanzi.definition: 1to rely upon; protector; to fight; war, weaponry

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) shows 仗 relates to a person's action or reliance on something.
丈 (zhàng) gives the exact sound of 仗.
衤 (clothing) — 袜 (socks) are an item of clothing.
末 (mò) gives a sound only distantly related to wà today, a connection that has faded over roughly three millennia of sound change.

makemeahanzi.definition: hook, barb, sickle; to hook, to link

etymology.hint: A metal 钅 hook 勾; 勾 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 钅 (metal) marks the material — hooks are typically made of metal.
勾 (a hook shape) sits beside it — a curved metal tool, giving 钩 its meaning 'hook.'

makemeahanzi.definition: considerably; very, extremely; a great extent

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart) — 愁 describes worry felt in the heart.
秋 (qiū) gives a sound distantly related to 愁's reading chóu, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: (esp.) to knock (mud from boots, ash from a pipe etc)

makemeahanzi.definition: to collide, to hit, to knock, to tap

characterDeckComponents.note: 石 (stone) — 磕 relates to knocking against something hard.
盍 (hé) gives a sound distantly related to 磕's reading kē, having drifted apart over time.
刂 (knife) — a form of 刀 (knife), marking the character as related to cutting.
弟 (dì) gives a sound close to 剃's reading tì — they share the same final, and the initials d/t differ only in aspiration.

makemeahanzi.definition: to stifle, to restrain, to choke; to suppress one's inner feelings

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart, mind) — 憋 (to suppress a feeling) is an internal, emotional state.
敝 (bì) gives a sound distantly related to biē, sharing the initial consonant but having drifted apart in vowel over time.

etymology.hint: The sap 氵 of the varnish tree 桼; 桼 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) suggests a liquid substance.
桼 depicts the varnish tree from which lacquer sap is drawn — combined with water, it shows the fluid taken from the tree.

etymology.hint: A hand 爫 over a woman 女, representing control

characterDeckComponents.note: A hand shape reaching down.
A woman, suggesting the idea of being properly managed or settled.
父 (father) — 爹 names a family relation, one's father.
多 (duō) gives a sound moderately close to diē, sharing the initial consonant.

makemeahanzi.definition: to collapse, to fall into ruin

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 塌 describes something, like a building or roof, sinking or collapsing to the ground.

makemeahanzi.definition: to prepare, to arrange; in advance

characterDeckComponents.note: 页 (head) — 预 relates to looking ahead or foreseeing beforehand
予 (yǔ) gives a sound close to 预's reading yù, differing mainly in tone
王 (jade) — 瑜 originally described a flawless jade gem.
俞 (yú) gives the sound — an exact match with 瑜's reading.
木 (tree) — 植 relates to planting trees and other plants.
直 (zhí) gives the sound — an exact match with 植's reading zhí.
疒 (sickness) — 疤 (a scar) is a mark left by injury, grouped with sickness-related characters.
巴 (bā) gives the sound — an exact match with 疤's reading.
木 (tree/wood) — 横 originally described a wooden crossbar or beam laid horizontally.
黄 (huáng) shares the initial h- with héng, though the rhyme has drifted.
忄 (heart) — 懒 describes an unmotivated, lazy state of mind.
赖 (lài) is close in initial to lǎn (both start with l-), though the rhyme has shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: to arouse, to incite; acute, sharp; fierce, violent

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 激 originally described water dashing or surging forcefully
敫 (jiǎo) gives a sound distantly related to 激's reading jī, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: strange, weird, supernatural; bewitching, enchanting, seductive

characterDeckComponents.note: Woman — many supernatural spirits in old stories were depicted as female.
Gives the sound yāo, matching the character's reading.

makemeahanzi.definition: to bind, to tie, to truss up; a bundle

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 捆 describes the action of tying something with the hands.
困 (kùn) gives a sound close to kǔn, the same syllable with a different tone.

meanings: abbr. for 媒體|媒体[mei2 ti3], media, esp. news media

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — 媒 originally described a woman who arranged marriages, 'a matchmaker.'
某 (mǒu) is only distantly related in sound to méi — the connection has drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to lift, to raise, to pry off a lid

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 撬 describes prying or levering something open by hand.
毳 (cuì) is the traditional phonetic element, but its modern reading has moved far from 撬's qiào — the connection today is historical rather than audible.

meanings: (bound form) to be a match for

makemeahanzi.definition: enemy, foe, rival; to match; to resist

characterDeckComponents.note: 攵 (to strike) — 敌 relates to conflict and opposition, as with an enemy
啇 (dí) gives a sound close to 敌's reading dí

etymology.hint: Storm 猋 winds 风; 猋 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 风 (wind) — 飙 names a violent, storm-force wind.
猋 (biāo, 'a pack of ferocious dogs; a storm') is an exact match for 飙's reading — 猋 itself is built from three dogs 犬, evoking a wild, gale-like fury.

makemeahanzi.definition: to avoid, to turn away; to escape, to hide

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — 避 means to avoid, moving away from something.
辟 (bì) gives the sound — an exact match with 避.
